description: This Java source file defines the base class for unchecked JSON-related exceptions within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class includes constructors, builder pattern, and accessors for error information, helping to standardize error handling for JSON processing errors.

classes.name: JsonRuntimeException
classes.description: A base class for all unchecked JSON-related exceptions, providing detailed error information such as error code, description, and link to more info.

classes.name: JsonRuntimeException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for fluently constructing instances of JsonRuntimeException with detailed error info.

methods.name: JsonRuntimeException
methods.description: Constructor initializing the exception with error code, message, description, cause and resource link.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new builder for JsonRuntimeException.

methods.name: getDescription

methods.name: getHref
